facts.text: Euro NCAP is the European consumer program that crash-tests cars and awards star ratings; its virtual-testing protocol is the first published procedure under which an outside assessor accepts manufacturer simulation results for crash avoidance, subject to correlation and random physical checks.
facts.quote: its virtual-testing protocol is the first published procedure under which an outside assessor accepts a manufacturer's simulation results for crash avoidance, subject to correlation and random physical checks.

entities.name: European New Car Assessment Programme (Euro NCAP)

facts.text: Euro NCAP is an independent consumer-assessment body backed by governments, motoring clubs and insurers, not a regulator. Euro NCAP stars are not legal approval, and its score is not regulatory evidence for any machine.
facts.quote: It is an independent consumer-assessment body backed by governments, motoring clubs and insurers; its stars are not legal approval and "its score is not regulatory evidence for any machine"

entities.name: European New Car Assessment Programme (Euro NCAP)

facts.text: For 2026 to 2028, Euro NCAP introduced what it calls its largest overhaul since 2009, adding robustness testing with varied speed and offset, real-world driving assessment prompted by complaints about annoying warnings or intrusive interventions, and virtual testing with spot checks.
facts.quote: For 2026 to 2028 it made what it calls its largest overhaul since 2009, adding robustness testing with varied speed and offset, real-world driving assessment prompted by complaints about "annoying warnings or intrusive interventions", and virtual testing with spot checks

facts.text: Euro NCAP's 2026 protocols contain more than 1,200 scenarios and use ISO 19206 targets.

facts.text: Euro NCAP's virtual-testing supporting protocol version 1.00 was dated March 2025 and entered into force in January 2026.
facts.quote: The virtual-testing supporting protocol (version 1.00, March 2025, in force January 2026)

facts.text: Under Euro NCAP's virtual-testing supporting protocol, the manufacturer submits a dossier of vehicle, sensor, target and environment models, qualifies its simulation in-house against physical tests using the ISO score and defined KPIs calculated with Euro NCAP scripts, and submits color-coded predictions for the whole scenario grid.
facts.quote: qualifies its simulation in-house against physical tests using "the ISO score and defined KPIs calculated using the Euro NCAP scripts", and submits color-coded predictions for the whole scenario grid.

entities.name: European New Car Assessment Programme (Euro NCAP)

facts.text: Euro NCAP physically tests randomly selected scenario-grid cells to verify submitted virtual-testing predictions.
facts.quote: Euro NCAP physically tests randomly selected grid cells.

entities.name: European New Car Assessment Programme (Euro NCAP)

facts.text: Euro NCAP accepts virtual results for a scenario cluster only if at least 75 percent of that cluster's verification tests meet qualification criteria. Otherwise, the dossier is rejected for that cluster and the manufacturer may re-simulate or test physically.
facts.quote: The virtual results are accepted for a scenario cluster only if at least 75 percent of the verification tests in that cluster meet the qualification criteria; otherwise the dossier is rejected for that cluster and the manufacturer may re-simulate or test physically

entities.name: European New Car Assessment Programme (Euro NCAP)

facts.text: Euro NCAP's virtual-testing protocol requires virtual sensor positions, opening angles and ranges to match the physical car, function logic to be similar, and target and environment models to match physical tests.
facts.quote: Virtual sensor positions, opening angles and ranges must match the physical car, function logic must be similar, and targets and environment models must match the physical tests

entities.name: European New Car Assessment Programme (Euro NCAP)

facts.text: Euro NCAP's virtual-testing protocol allows perfect perception to be assumed, limiting its value as a sensor-robustness precedent: the protocol cannot establish that a camera works in dust or glare.
facts.quote: The protocol allows "perfect perception" to be assumed, "which limits its value as a precedent for sensor robustness": it cannot establish that a camera works in dust or glare
